name: Office Lunch Planner API
description: Plan lunch for a team: collect preferences, build a group order, optimize to budget, and prepare a human-approved checkout. /plan-office-lunch returns suggested_order, per_person_cost, substitutions, delivery_eta, and approval_required in one call. Payment and order submission are execution-gated. Built for executive assistant and workplace-ops agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Plan a $240 lunch for 12 people with vegetarian, gluten-free, and nut-allergy constraints.
Optimize an over-budget group order down to a per-person cap.
Aggregate scattered team dietary preferences into a single order spec.
Prepare a checkout for manager approval before any payment.

agentUseCases.workflow: Weekly: /plan-office-lunch → present plan → /prepare-checkout for manager approval token.
Recurring team-lunch automation with budget guardrails and approval gating.
Collect RSVPs + diets, build the order, and route payment for sign-off.

human_approval_required.reason: Payment and final order submission move money and are irreversible; an explicit human approval token is required. /prepare-checkout is a no-charge-risk preview only.

chain_to.reason: Source restaurants for the team's cuisine preferences.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Call /plan-office-lunch with people_count, budget, diets, cuisines.
Preview totals via /prepare-checkout, then submit /submit-order with a human approval token to pay.

examplePrompts: Plan lunch for 12 people, $240 budget, with vegetarian and gluten-free options.
Optimize this order to stay under $20 per person.
Build a Mediterranean group order for the team Thursday at noon.
Prepare checkout for my manager to approve.
